name: Satei Adjusters
description: Satei Adjusters is a quiet, horizontal-strip WordPress landing theme crafted for independent loss-adjusting desks and specialised consultancy practices. Flooded in muted mauve tones with refined sans typography, it pairs sticky split-screen narratives and hairline section openers with structured case records and fixed-fee schedules. Designed for deliberate restraint, the layout highlights evidence-first professionalism with responsive precision.

summary.en: A waitlist landing page for an independent loss-adjusting desk: a wordmark hero over a low-key photograph, hairline section openers, a colour-flooded sticky split, a photo strip and a mauve FAQ band.
